svg.title: Engineering Stack
svg.desc: Languages: C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, MATLAB; Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query; Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, JWT, OAuth2; AI / ML / GenAI: LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, Gemini, RAG, ChromaDB, Streamlit, Scikit-learn, Random Forest; Computer Vision & Scientific Computing: YOLO, OpenCV, RDKit, ChEMBL, Pandas, NumPy, Joblib; Databases & ORM: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Drizzle ORM; Cloud, DevOps & Tools: Docker, AWS, Git, GitHub, VS Code, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Figma
